title: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B | TechCrunch
summary: Hugging Face last raised in 2023 at a $4.5 billion post-money valuation in a round led by Salesforce Ventures, with participation from Alphabet, GV, IBM Ventures, and others. TechCrunch has reached out to Hugging Face for more information.
